title: Armoede onderzoek Europa 1979
authors: Hagenaars, A.J.M., Praag, B.M.S. van, Centrum voor onderzoek van de economie van de publieke sector, COEPS * Leiden (primary investigator)
contributors: Agricultural institute economics and rural welfare research centre
Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek * Voorburg, the Netherlands
Psychologisch Laboratorium, afd. Groepspsychologie, UvA * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Describing how people evaluate their income. Working hours of respondent and partner / stability of income / sources of income of household / evaluation of different levels of income, what level of income is considered to be insufficient / evaluation of own level of income and income of parental household / purchases for which extra income is needed. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class
